summary.text: Customers find the ratchet tool to be of good quality, powerful, and easy to work with. They appreciate its functionality, with one customer noting it's perfect for trimming bushes like spirea and yew shrubs, and another mentioning it makes it easier to get into tight spots. The tool's weight is manageable, and customers like its battery life, with one noting it doesn't drain the batteries significantly. Durability receives mixed reviews, with some customers reporting great durability while others mention it breaks easily under medium to high torque.
